What it solves

A full ERP is a year-long project that almost nobody finishes

The classic way to buy an ERP is to sign for everything at once, pay for a long rollout and start using it once the business has already changed. That is why so many companies stay on spreadsheets: it is not that they do not want a system, it is that the system they are offered cannot be started one piece at a time.

  • Rolling out a full ERP is a months-long project
  • You pay for modules you will never use
  • Growing means buying another program that does not talk to the first
  • The same data gets typed in three places
  • Each company in the group ends up with its own system
  • Moving into another country means redoing the whole tax setup

What is included

What you actually get

You start with one module

Invoicing, Inventory, Payroll — whichever is pressing. The rest come later on the same data, with no migration and no second project.

One database, not integrations

The modules do not sync: they read the same data. That is the difference from a bundle of programs wired together with bridges.

Genuinely multi-company

Several companies in the same group, each with its own accounting, its own numbering and its data completely separate from the rest.

Your country's tax rules

Dominican Republic, Venezuela, Colombia, Guatemala and Costa Rica, each with its own tax, its own receipt and its filings to the right authority.

Multi-currency end to end

Every document in its own currency, with its rate and its exchange difference calculated on collection or payment. It is not a field: it is the whole journey.

Nothing to install

You use it from the browser, with backups and updates included. There is no server to maintain and no version to upgrade.

How it works

In three steps

  1. Choose where to start

    The module that solves whatever eats the most of your time today.

  2. We set up your company

    Country, currency, taxes and the chart of accounts of your jurisdiction.

  3. You operate

    And you add modules when you need them, on the same data.

In detail

What you notice using it every day

Accounting can be added later

The modules work without it and start posting entries once it is switched on. You do not need everything on day one to start using something.

Two companies' data never mixes

Nor two subscribers'. Every query, dropdown and report is scoped by both dimensions, always. It is the promise everything else rests on.

We maintain the official catalogues

The tax register, the UN/LOCODE ports and the Ministry job codes. For you they are read-only: you never have to load or update them.

Every module brings its help and its dictionary

A panel per screen, an explanation per field and the documentation of your data. You do not need a course to use a new screen.

There are vertical editions, not just modules

Restaurant, Car Wash, Condominiums, Prestamello. If your business has its own way of operating, there is a vertical edition or one gets built.

The price is published

Per module and per plan, on this very site. You do not have to request a quote to know what you are looking at costs.

Common questions

Questions

Do I have to subscribe to every module?

No. You subscribe to the ones you use and add the rest whenever you like, with no migration: they come in on the same data.

How long until it is up and running?

The same day to start operating. What takes time is loading your master records, and we help with that.

Does it work for several companies?

Yes, each with its own accounting, its own tax numbering and its data completely separate.

Which countries does it work in?

Dominican Republic, Venezuela, Colombia, Guatemala and Costa Rica, each with its own tax, receipts and official filings.

What if my business is very particular?

There are vertical editions for restaurants, car washes, condominiums and lending; and if yours is not there, we build it on the same platform.

Where can I see the pricing?

Published in the Platform section of this very site, module by module.
